# Differential cases

Each case is a disagreement between markfmt and goldmark v2.0.2 that
`FuzzDifferential` found (design 11.5). The section of a case gives its
verdict and its rule: "fixed in markfmt", or "goldmark deviates" with the spec
section. The expected HTML is the output of `cmark --unsafe` 0.31.1.

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.6 and 6.6: a declaration starts with `<!` and an ASCII letter

goldmark needs an uppercase letter, as GitHub does (`../dialect.md`).

```````````````````````````````` example
x<!x>

<!doctype html>
.
<p>x<!x></p>
<!doctype html>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.6: `meta` is not in the tag list of HTML block kind 6

`<meta>` is an HTML block of kind 7, which cannot interrupt a paragraph.

```````````````````````````````` example
a
<meta>
.
<p>a
<meta></p>
````````````````````````````````
